title: JourneyTestContract
description: Machine-readable contract defining the testing obligations, authority requirements, capabilities, and settlement criteria for a canonical user journey in SEA-Forge.

journey_id.description: Canonical Journey ID, CJ01 through CJ12.

canonical_journey_name.description: Canonical Journey name matching canonical-journey-catalog.md and interaction-model.sea.

source_story_ids.description: List of observed story IDs from canonicalization-matrix.csv mapped to this journey.

source_story_classifications.description: Distribution of story classifications mapped to this journey.

implementation_maturity.description: Distribution of story implementation maturities mapped to this journey.

starting_state.description: The initial state / initiating condition required to begin the journey.

preconditions.description: Preconditions that must hold before the journey begins.

authority_requirements.description: Authority decisions, disclosure permissions, or approval gates required.

expected_capabilities.description: Capabilities / verbs invoked during this journey.

expected_consequential_state_transitions.description: Material state transitions that must occur during execution.

required_artifacts_and_evidence.description: Authoritative records, digests, artifacts, or ledger entries produced.

settlement_condition.description: Authoritative, independent settlement condition determining PASS.

expected_next_decisions_and_affordances.description: Affordances and decisions that must become spendable upon settlement.

applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior.description: Lawful failure modes, denial explanations, and recovery paths.

expected_unavailable_states.description: Interfaces or features that are preview-only or canonically unavailable and must fail closed.
